metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the Rust Cargo project under [output/Cargo.toml](/workspace/output/Cargo.toml) with the binary entry point at [output/src/main.rs](/workspace/output/src/main.rs). It parses `.bib`, `.bst`, cite lists and `.aux`, executes the standard BibTeX-style stack language, writes `.bbl` output, and emits the requested JSON log or error JSON.

Verified with:

```bash
cargo build --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml
cargo run --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml -- --bib output/test.bib --style docs/authoritative/plain.bst --cites output/test.cites --output output/out.bbl --log output/out.json
cargo run --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml -- --bib output/test.bib --style docs/authoritative/alpha.bst --cites output/test.cites --output output/alpha.bbl --log output/alpha.json
```

I also added small sample inputs under `output/` for sanity testing: `test.bib`, `test.cites`, `crossref.bib`, and `crossref.cites`.

    def run_bibtex(
